name: dilaya-dev
description: Dilaya: describe how you work and ChatGPT builds your own software (database, files, web space with email sign-in), hosted and run by Dilaya.

interface.longDescription:
Dilaya turns a description of how you work into your own software. You describe what you do, in your own words, the way you would explain it to a colleague. ChatGPT builds the software. Dilaya is where it stays and runs: a database of your own, file storage, a web space with email sign-in. Nothing to install, nothing to configure.

You use it in two ways. Right in the chat: you say "Add Mrs Garnier's order for 14 May, €320 still to pay" and it is recorded, with the balance still owed. And at your own address, for your customers or your team: a site, a booking page, a members area, accounts that sign in, data that stays.

What people build for themselves: order tracking with costs and what is left to invoice, a quote generator built from supplier sheets, a booking space, a member directory with sign-ups and the calendar, tracking for building sites, case files or stock. It also works on its own when you ask it to: it sorts the mail, chases a customer, tells you on Telegram.

It changes with you. One more column, a rule that changes, a screen to add: you say it, and the software is updated.

Your data stays yours.

A Dilaya account is required.
capabilities: Build a custom business app from a description
Record and query your data in the chat
Publish a web space with email sign-in
defaultPrompt: Create a space to track my orders: customer, delivery date, total, balance due.
Add Mrs Garnier's order for 14 May, €320 still to pay.
Which orders are late, and who still owes us money?
